chapter.verse: “Keimah in leenggah gui ka hi a, ka Pa in leenggah gui locingpa ahi hi.
Kei tungah a gahlo hiangte khempeuh a sattan ding hi. A gah thei hiang khempeuh in a gah semsem nadingin a hahsiang ding hi.
Ka thuhilhna hangin note tu-in na siangtho uh hi.

Kei sungah om un. Keimah in zong note sungah ka om ding hi. Leenggah hiang in gui tungah a om kei leh, ama ut bangin a gah zo lo bangin, note in zong keima sungah na om kei uh leh, na gah zo kei ding uh hi.

Keimah in leenggah gui ka hi hi. Note in a hiang na hi uh hi. Keima sungah om a, ama sungah ka om leh, tua mi in tampi a gah thei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kei sungah na om kei uh leh, bangmah na hih thei kei ding uh hi.
Kei sungah a om lote in a kipaiikhia hiangte bangin a kikeusak hi. Tua ciangin mite in khawm uh a, mei sungah khulin mei in a kangtum hi.
Kei sungah na om uh a, ka thu in note sungah a om leh, na ngetpeuh peuh uh na ngah ding uh hi.
Note in tampi na gah uh leh, ka Pa’ minthan’na na kilangsak ding uh a, note in ka nungzuite na hi takpi ding uh hi.
Pa in kei hong it bangin no kong it hi; ka itna sungah om un.
Keimah in ka Pa’ thupiaknate zui a, hong itna sungah ka om mah bangin, note in ka thupiaknate na zuih uh leh, kei sungah na om ding uh hi.
Note sungah ka lungdamna om a, note lungdamna a kicin’ nadingin hih thute note kiangah kong gen zo hi.”
“Ka thupiakna ahih leh, keimah in no kong it mah bangin note khat leh khat na ki-it un.
Ama lawmte tangding a nuntakna a paai itna sangin, itna lianzaw kuamah in a nei kei hi.
Note in ka thupiakna bangin na hih uh leh, ka lawmte na hi ding uh hi.

Tu-a kipanin note sila kong ci nawn kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, silate in a topa bawlna thu a thei kei uh hi. Lawmte kong ci ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka Pa kiangah thu ka zakte no kong theisak zo hi.

Note in kei nong teel kei uh hi; no kong teel hi. Note pai-in, a tampi na gah khit uh ciangin, na gah uh a kip nadingin kong koih zo hi; tua ciangin ka min tawh thu na nget khempeuh uh Pa in hong pia ding hi.
Hih in keima thupiakna ahi hi; Khat leh khat na ki-it un.”
“Leitung mite in no hong muhdah uh leh, note hong muhdah ma-in kei hong mudah uh hi ci-in na thei ta un.

Note in leitung mite tawh na kipawl uh leh, leitung mite in amau mipawl note hong it ding uh hi. Ahih hangin leitung mite lak pan note kong teelkhia hi; leitung mite tawh na kipawl kei uh a, tua ahih ciangin leitung mite in no hong mudah uh hi.

‘Sila in a topa sangin lianzaw kei,’ ci-in ka gensa thu na ngaihsun un. Amau in kei hong bawlsia uh ahih manin note zong hong bawlsia ding uh hi. Amau in kei thu zui le-uh, note thu zong a zui ding uh hi.
Amau in kei hong sawlpa thei lo uh ahih ciangin, ka min hangin tua thu khempeuh no tungah hong bawl ding uh hi.
Kei hong pai loin amau kiangah thu hilh lo hi leng, amaute in mawhna a nei kei ding uh hi. Tu-in ahih leh, amau mawhna pan suahtak theih nading a nei kei uh hi.
Kei hong mudah mi in ka Pa zong a mudah hi.
Midangte in a bawl ngei loh nalamdangte amaute lakah bawl lo hi leng, mawhna a nei kei ding uh hi. Ahih hangin tu-in amaute in hih nalamdangte mu khin napi-in kei leh ka Pa hong mudah veve uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, ‘Thu om loin kei hong mudah uh hi,’ ci-in amau Thukhamna sungah a kigelh bangin a tun’ nading ahi hi.”
“Pa kiang pan a pusuak, thuman thutak Kha Siangtho ahi Pa kiang pan no kiangah kong sawl ding Huhpa in a hong tun’ ciangin, keima ading teci a pang ding hi.
Note in zong a cil pan akipan kei tawh omkhawm na hih uh ciangin, teci na pang ding uh hi.”
